pexels_alt: Crowd celebrating in Buenos Aires after Argentina's 2022 World Cup win
description: Dense crowd of people packed into a city street/plaza in daylight, many wearing light-blue-and-white striped shirts and holding light-blue-and-white flags. Several individuals are perched on top of traffic-light poles; one wears a dark green jersey printed 'MESSI 10' on the back, another on a pole to the left wears the light-blue-and-white striped shirt. A tall stone obelisk/monument stands in the background left, ornate classical stone buildings line the right, and a black street sign reads 'Viamonte 1100‑1200' beside a red no‑parking sign. People in the crowd hold up phones and flags.

pexels_alt: Vibrant street celebration in Buenos Aires with football fans and drums

pexels_alt: People celebrating with flags and a trophy on a Buenos Aires balcony

Several men wear white t‑shirts and light‑blue‑and‑white vertically striped shirts; one man on the right raises a golden trophy overhead with both arms, another lifts a cup to drink, and others raise their arms in celebration.
